Closure invariant: without persisted verification photos/track, case stays open (verifying) and alarms fire; dose/mixture/flight plan are out of scope.<br/>4. S3 hierarchy (KMS objects, 5y retention): farms/{farm_id}/cases|campaigns/.../{mission_id}/; ungranted or person_present objects quarantined/restricted.<br/>5. div.div:
1. Human authorization invariant (ADR-002): only a Federation agronomist (MFA <= 10 min) authorizes; authorizer != pilot; no trigger ever authorizes.
2. Offline resilience: mission package preloaded before takeoff (VLAN 102 or municipal seat); encrypted buffer holds record/photos until link returns.
3. Closure invariant: without persisted verification photos/track, case stays open (verifying) and alarms fire; dose/mixture/flight plan are out of scope.
4. S3 hierarchy (KMS objects, 5y retention): farms/{farm_id}/cases|campaigns/.../{mission_id}/; ungranted or person_present objects quarantined/restricted.
5. Dashed lines = offline flight/buffering or async response; solid lines = live API, MQTT, S3 upload, or state transition.

a.text: Text is not SVG - cannot display
